name: Signifer Warmage (Warmage Archetype)
body:
The hellknights are a terrible and militant order. While most of their signifers are priests or conjurers, some are trained to be warmages to bring powerful offensive magic to bear on the unlawful.

Requirements

Alignment: A signifer warmage must be lawfully-aligned.

Aura of Law (Ex)

The power of a signifer warmage’s aura of law (see detect law) is equal to their total character level.

Catechesis (Ex)

A signifer warmage is given some training in the religious aspects of the hellknights, which gives them a hardened mind and body. The signifer warmage gains Warrior Priest as a bonus feat without needing to meet its prerequisites. This ability replaces Combat Casting.

Order (Ex)

A signifer warmage must join an order of hellknights.

Signifer Armor Training (Ex)

At 2nd level, the signifer warmage is used to wearing armor on a regular basis. They reduce the armor check penalty of their armor worn by 1. This further reduces the penalty by 1 at 9th and 16th levels. This ability replaces focused mind.

Signifer Mask (Ex)

At 4th level, a signifer warmage has earned the right to bear their signifer mask. They must pass the test and kill a devil single-handedly before getting their mask. Once they do, they receive a signifer mask which grants the signifer warmage a +2 competence bonus on Sense Motive checks and on saves against visual effects.

Additionally, the signifer mask can be used once per day to cast any one spell that the signifer warmage has in their spellbook and is capable of casting, even if the spell is not prepared. This spell is treated like any other spell cast by the signifer warmage, including casting time, duration, and other effects dependent on the warmage’s level. This spell cannot be modified by metamagic feats or other abilities.

The signifer warmage can add special abilities to their signifer mask as any other wondrous item as if they have the Craft Wondrous Item feat, so long as they meet the level requirements of the feat.

This ability replaces the bonus feat gained at 4th level.

Discern Lies (Sp)

At 5th level, a signifer warmage can use discern lies as a spell-like ability a number of times per day equal to 3 plus their Intelligence modifier.

Their caster level is equal to their class level. This ability replaces the arcane strategy gained at 5th level.

Assiduous Gaze (Su/Sp)

At 7th level and again at 12th level, a signifer warmage gains an assiduous gaze ability chosen from the list below. A signifer warmage can use each assiduous gaze ability they possess for a number of rounds per day equal to 1/2 their class level.

These rounds need not be consecutive. A signifer warmage can activate an assiduous gaze ability as a swift action to examine a single creature, object, or 5-foot square within 30 feet. A signifer warmage must be wearing their signifer mask to use these abilities, and their caster level while using them is equal to their class level.

Elucidation (Su)

Discern each active spell on the target, including the spell’s effect and caster level.

Morality (Sp)

Determine whether the target is chaotic, evil, good, or lawful, as well as the strength of its aura as if having studied it for 3 rounds using detect chaos, detect evil, detect good, and detect law.

Scrutiny (Su)

Discern whether the target has spell-like abilities and spellcasting abilities, whether the spellcasting ability is arcane or divine, and the strength (see detect magic) of the most powerful spell or spell-like ability the target currently has available.

Veracity (Sp)

Observe the target as if using true seeing. A signifer warmage must be 12th level to select this ability.

Vigilance (Su)

See through up to 5 feet of stone, wood, or similar barriers as if they didn’t exist. This effect cannot penetrate metal of any kind.

This ability replaces the arcane strategy gained at 7th level and the bonus feat gained at 12th level.

Hellknight Armor (Ex)

At 8th level, a signifer warmage learns the skills to cast their magics while in the bulky hellknight armor. They can cast spells without an arcane spell failure chance while in armor with “hellknight” in the name. They are also proficient with such armor, this does not extend to other medium or heavy armors. This ability replaces armored mage.

Infernal Resilience (Ex)

At 11th level, a signifer warmage gains DR 5/chaotic and becomes immune to poison. This ability replaces the arcane strategy gained at 11th level.

Diabolic Harbinger (Su)

At 15th level, as long as the signifer warmage wears their signifer mask, they gain telepathy with a range of 100 feet, and can see perfectly in both magical and mundane darkness. While wearing their signifer mask, they are immune to blindness and dazzling effects and gains a +2 bonus on all Charismabased checks when interacting with lawful creatures.

This bonus increases to +4 if the creature is also an outsider. This ability replaces the arcane strategy gained at 15th level and the bonus feat gained at 20th level.
